About.title: About

sections.heading: Why Quested
sections.body: I always wanted to make a site a bit like Letterboxd, but I've been playing video games since I was a kid, so I wanted to make it for games instead of movies.

sections.heading: Free, no ads, open source
sections.body: It matters to me that this kind of app stays accessible to everyone. Quested is free, ad-free, and the source code is entirely public on GitHub. It will stay that way.

sections.heading: Who I am
sections.body: I'm Arnaud, a French fullstack developer. Quested is a personal project I build on my free time. You can check out my other projects at arnaudroyer.fr.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Question, bug, idea? Reach me at contact@arnaudroyer.fr.

Legal.privacyIntro: This page explains what data Quested collects, why, and how you can control it.

privacySections.heading: Data collected
privacySections.body:
When signing in with Google or Discord: your name, email address and profile picture.
When using the site: the games you add to your library, their status, your rating and your personal notes.

privacySections.heading: Purpose
privacySections.body: This data is only used to run the service: authenticate you, display your public profile, and power your game library.

privacySections.heading: Who receives this data
privacySections.body: Google or Discord (authentication), Neon (database hosting, European Union), Vercel (site hosting). IGDB and RAWG are used to search for games but never receive your personal data, only the search terms.

privacySections.heading: Retention period
privacySections.body: Your data is kept as long as your account exists, and deleted immediately and permanently if you delete your account.

privacySections.heading: Cookies
privacySections.body: Quested only uses a session cookie strictly necessary for signing in. No advertising or analytics cookies are used.

privacySections.heading: Your rights
privacySections.body: You can export or delete all your data at any time from the Account page. For any other request (rectification, question), contact contact@arnaudroyer.fr. You can also file a complaint with your local data protection authority.
